evidence.excerpt: Over multiple seeds, ComCLIP matches the self-distillation baseline CLIP-Refine on zero-shot classification while significantly improving the transferability of visual features, measured by linear probing ($48.99$ vs.\ $42.28$ on ViT-B/16), and on ViT-L/14 it also improves MMVP over CLIP-Refine ($24.20$ vs.\ $19.01$); CLIP-Refine remains stronger on image-text retrieval.
